title: The Data-Centre Energy-Control Claim Qualification Benchmark
description: October 2026 preprint by Babasola Adeboye Osibo, MBL, MS, Pentrest Global (b.osibo@pentrestglobal.com). The Data-Centre Energy-Control Claim Qualification Benchmark evaluates data-centre controller cost claims using service qualification across training seeds, common terminal accounting, causal information boundaries, and a same-model hindsight reference. The manuscript reports benchmark version 0.2.1; release v0.2.2 includes the PDF and accompanying software, figures and compact results.
